author: DylL
quote:
The plot is pure stupidity. Imagine ur ex calling you in jail because she rob bank with her kid, that claimed to be yours. And your reaction is just simply “this is the best day of my life, I’m a father now”. /why she called after she went in jail when she risk her baby to rob a bank. Even though later it gives me an explanation, I probably not gonna buy it.

This GTA doesn’t feel like GTA, and the plot is just too terrible to be RDR. The start takes more time to disappear, less freedom on weapon and stealing cars. This is not the essence of GTA.

Not mentioning the hardware issue, standard ps5 will have a hard time running this game. When there’s a shooting or going in to plants, it will drop the fps from 30 to 22.

I question the accuracy of those critics, are they really played this game? Or just like maggots tryna get some hot ****?
